Ribd Copper Insulated Copper Bottle with Flip Top Lid

Experience the perfect blend of tradition, innovation, and modern convenience with the Ribd Copper Insulated Copper Bottle with flip top lid. Designed for today’s active lifestyle, this premium insulated bottle combines the purity of copper with advanced double-wall insulation to keep your beverages hot or cold for 4–6 hours. Whether you’re at the office, gym, traveling, or outdoors, this bottle ensures optimal temperature retention while maintaining a stylish, contemporary look.

Unlike traditional copper bottles, this insulated double wall copper bottle features an inner lining made of pure copper and an outer PU-based insulated plastic shell. This intelligent design not only enhances durability but also eliminates common issues such as external black spots, making maintenance effortless and hassle-free.

Double Wall Insulation with Pure Copper Inner Lining

The inner lining of this is crafted from 100% pure copper, known for its natural benefits and premium appeal. Copper has been traditionally used for storing water, and this modern adaptation preserves that heritage while adding superior insulation. The double wall insulated design helps maintain beverage temperature for extended periods, making it an ideal hot and cold insulated copper bottle for everyday use. The outer PU-based plastic shell provides excellent insulation without compromising on weight or grip. This ensures the remains comfortable to hold and safe to carry, even when filled with hot liquids.

Convenient Flip-Top Lid for On-the-Go Use

Designed with practicality in mind, the flip top lid copper bottle allows easy one-handed operation, making it perfect for busy routines. Whether you’re commuting, working out, or traveling, the spill-resistant flip-top lid ensures smooth sipping without leaks or mess.

  • Flip-top lid for easy sipping on the go
  • Leak-resistant design for safe portability
  • Ideal for office, gym, travel, and outdoor use

Keeps Beverages Hot or Cold for 4–6 Hours

Thanks to its advanced insulated design, this copper insulated bottle keeps hot beverages warm and cold drinks refreshingly cool for up to 4–6 hours. Enjoy your tea, coffee, infused water, or juice at the right temperature, anytime and anywhere. This makes it a reliable choice for users looking for a double wall copper water bottle that performs consistently throughout the day.

No More Black Spots – Easy to Maintain

One of the most common issues with traditional copper is oxidation and black spots forming on the outer surface. With this ribbed insulated copper bottle, that problem is eliminated. The outer insulated shell protects the copper interior while keeping the exterior clean, smooth, and easy to maintain.

  • No black spots on the outside
  • Easy to clean and maintain
  • Long-lasting shine and finish

Elegant Ribbed Design That Turns Heads

A beautiful ribbed texture gives this bottle a premium, eye-catching appearance. The modern design seamlessly blends traditional copper aesthetics with contemporary styling, making it a perfect accessory for professionals and style-conscious users alike. Whether placed on a desk or carried outdoors, this stylish insulated copper bottle is sure to make a statement while delivering unmatched functionality.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Inner lining made of pure copper
  • Outer PU-based insulated plastic shell
  • Double wall insulated design
  • Keeps hot and cold beverages for 4–6 hours
  • Flip-top lid for easy, spill-free sipping
  • No external black spots
  • Elegant ribbed finish with premium look

Upgrade your hydration experience with the— a perfect fusion of purity, performance, and modern design. Ideal for daily use or premium gifting, this delivers both functionality and style in one smart solution.
